title: Pearl Harbor City Tour
includes: Historic Downtown Honolulu: Drive by King Kamehameha Statue, Iolani Palace, State Capitol
Food and drinks (Snacks are available for purchase at the Pearl Harbor Visitor Center at own expense) (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Dress code is smart casual. Dress comfortably, but please remember that shirts and shoes are required on the USS Arizona Memorial and swimsuits are not permitted. High heels, dresses, and skirts not recommended
Security restrictions at Pearl Harbor will be enforced. Please do not bring large bags or anything that could offer concealment. Storage is available at Pearl Harbor for $7.00
Guide reserves the right to adjust route for maximum visitor enjoyment and safety

On rare occasions, the Navy unexpectedly suspends shuttle operations to the USS Arizona Memorial. In such case, you will still be able to visit the many Arizona Memorial exhibits, film, visitor's center and park monuments
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Come along on this 5 hour tour of historical sites, including the Historic Downtown Honolulu, Pearl Harbor National Memorial and the USS Arizona Memorial.
